content.comment_body: Hello, I need to connect a [product_name] ([article_no]) to a computer via Ethernet. I have developed a Visual Basic program on the computer. Is it possible to establish communication with Visual Basic? Any advice is appreciated.

To transfer data from the [product_name] to a PC, you will need an OPC-Server that supports communication with [product_name]. I suggest considering S7-200 PC-Access, or exploring other available OPC-Servers. If you have experience in programming, you might try using the Excel-Logger mentioned in the forum or look for alternative solutions discussed there. If you are not an advanced user, a PC-Server solution is likely the simplest option. I hope this assists you.

analysis.insight_summary: The user looks for guidance on connecting a [product_name] device to a custom Visual Basic application through Ethernet. The primary concern is the absence of a straightforward way for Visual Basic to access data from [product_name]. Suggested solutions include using an OPC-Server as an intermediary. The discussion highlights that users with limited technical skills encounter challenges due to the lack of direct integration options.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an uncomplicated solution to enable data exchange between [product_name] and a Visual Basic program using Ethernet, preferably not requiring advanced technical expertise.
